items.q: This is what Jim McNeely was doing with Jon Faddis and that orchestra...

ctx.x: That’s James Zimmerman and Ken Kimery.

James Zimmerman and Ken Kimery – that we were really going into a cul-de­ sac, that there’s only so much you can do. For instance, people were asking, why – if you’re going to make a CD, why should I buy your CD when I can get the original? It was a conundrum. You’d say, “Well, ah, duh duh duh.” They were right, and we had to start reexamining our premises about what it meant. I think very compelling arguments were made by both of the aforementioned gentlemen that “jazz masterworks” meant “jazz masterworks,” and…
